name: Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu - § 17/3
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: ‘stresses the need for targeted and evidence-based measures to close regulatory gaps in current marketing and advertising practices while further looking into the impact of harmful alcohol consumption, particularly at levels exceeding scientifically established health recommendations, energy drinks and so-called ultra-processed foods on people’s health;’
